title: synostemon elachophyllus subsp. latior
intro: Synostemon elachophyllus subsp. latior, commonly known as a type of plant native to Australia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help in the treatment of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Synostemon elachophyllus subsp. latior include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
